scope: Automatic quick card; contextual rules across all profiles; mathematical consistency, not proof of gameplay optimality
limitations: Class rotations, item passives and contextual rules remain estimated where champion formulas are absent.
All pair policies were checked computationally; they were not individually manually reviewed.
Exhaustive full-build optimizer audit of 451530 combinations was not rerun in this change.
Greedy ranking is not a proof of global optimality.
Support builds may legitimately match against enemies with the same removable-CC need.

Affinity pools across all automatic profiles with legal sparse-pool expansion
